description: Envoy Gateway at a glance: status, traffic, status codes, response time, routes and the proxy's own cost.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Worst state across Envoy pods. Anything but LIVE needs attention.

panels.title: Success
panels.description: Responses in the selected range that were not server errors (5xx).

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests from clients in the selected range.

panels.title: Under 100 ms
panels.description: Requests that finished within 100 ms. Streams and long-polls run longer by design.

panels.title: Served
panels.description: Bytes sent to clients in the selected range.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Client connections open now, with their trend.

panels.title: Errors per hour
panels.description: Error responses from routes, by status code. 4xx: refused or not found. 5xx: the gateway or a backend failed.

panels.title: Slow requests per hour

panels.title: Requests per second

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bytes sent to clients (up) and received from them (down).

panels.title: Traffic by route
panels.description: Each route's average traffic over the range and share of non-5xx responses. Click a route to drill in.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU per Envoy pod, as a share of one core.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working-set memory per Envoy pod.

panels.title: Envoy heap
panels.description: Envoy's own memory: in use by live objects, resident in RAM, and reserved from the OS.

panels.title: Heap pressure
panels.description: Heap use against Envoy's overload limit; it sheds load near 100 %.

panels.title: Worker balance
panels.description: Client connections on the busiest worker thread against the average. Under load, a wide gap means one thread carries it.

panels.title: Event loop stalls per hour
panels.description: Watchdog misses: a thread stalled, delaying every request on it. Expect zero.

panels.title: Config updates per hour
panels.description: Config pushes from Envoy Gateway. Rejected: Envoy refused it. Failed: usually the control plane restarting.

panels.title: Config apply time
panels.description: Slowest 1 % of config updates to apply in the range, by kind. Big route or cluster sets take longest.

panels.title: Control plane connection
panels.description: Whether each pod is connected to Envoy Gateway. Traffic flows either way; config changes wait.

panels.title: DNS lookups per hour
panels.description: Lookups Envoy made for clusters addressed by hostname, and those that timed out.
